messages:
maya: Strange one: deployed a config that sets route.timeout = false (to mean 'unset') and router started applying timeout=0 which trips the quota/rl logic.
ishaan: Wait we treat timeout as optional int; false is boolean. Where did false come from? UI allowed toggling 'clear value' and serialized as false?
maya: Yep. Console toggle sends `{timeout: false}` when user clears the field. Backend config-store used a permissive JSON column so the type survived. Router unmarshalling coerces false -> 0 for legacy path.
kevin: That explains alerts: routes got zero timeout -> aggressive retries and double-counting in metrics. Ouch.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: applied cfg-2026-12 to staging at 1765559987 :gear:
ishaan: Immediate mitigation: patch router to treat boolean false as explicit 'unset' for known typed fields. But we should also stop UI from sending raw false for scalar clears.
maya: Short-term hotfix: add a config linting webhook that rejects mismatched types (eg boolean for int fields) with clear error. I'll open PR.
kevin: Also add a Prometheus derived metric `config_type_mismatch_total{route,field}` so we can alert when a route has a mismatch >0.
ishaan: Longer term: add typed-schema on config-store and run a migration that normalizes `null` for cleared fields, and update console to submit `null` instead of false.
maya: (typo)
maya: I'll own the lint webhook + console patch. Kevin: can you own the router guard and metric? Ishaan: you own the schema addr + migration plan.
ishaan: Plan: 1) lint webhook (hot, few hours), 2) router guard + metric (hotfix), 3) console change (feature flagged), 4) schema migration and backfill (boarded).
kevin: I'll also add a visible callout in console on route detail if last applied config had any type mismatches. That should help product owners notice before rollout.
maya: Thanks. Opening PRs and tagging oncall/infra. :white_check_mark:
